d: Spiky, short lemon-yellow hair stands up in a bold style, paired with narrow, sharp amber eyes and a confident expression. The face is that of a mature young adult with a lean, athletic build. The outfit consists of polished white and silver plate armor with blue accents, featuring a high collar of dark grey fur and a long, flowing dark grey cape with a blue interior lining. A glowing green orb is embedded in the center of the chest plate.
